crusadecraft.trade.income: +%s coins a day for each side, over %s blocks of road.
crusadecraft.codex.commerce.p0: A $(l)trade treaty$() (at the Dovecote) opens a route between your capital and the other realm's. It shows on the realm map, as golden dots, and on Dynmap, in the $(l)Trade routes$() layer.
crusadecraft.codex.commerce.p1: Every day the route brings gold: a base share, plus one coin per 400 blocks of road (ten at most). Merchants travel for what is not found at home: distant routes are worth more.
